ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 rider cancellation fee; no refund. Optionally note the driver's non-arrival for coaching (the rider's remedy is a RydeHELP fee-waiver request within 30 days under NS-7).

rejected_claims.reason: Ryde publishes no rule that a late/absent driver makes rider cancellation free; NS-8 is informative and non-citable, and no ETA-expiry field exists. The 3-minute chargeable window in NS-4 was exceeded [F2].
A rider-side cancellation is not a driver-caused no-show claim; NS-1/NS-2 apply only when the driver cancels citing rider no-show and are procedurally inapplicable.
